# MM-P3-L2-SB01 - Maintenance manual - Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1

Revision: Rev A  
Plant: P3, line P3-L2  
Equipment: EQ-P3-L2-SB01

Scope
This document defines the preventive maintenance tasks, inspection criteria, and records required for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) in plant P3, line P3-L2. It covers routine access, lining inspection and replacement guidance, shot media replenishment, and verification activities needed to maintain cleaning performance and component life. Use this manual in conjunction with ECN-2026-019 and SOP-P3-L2-01 for change notices and safe work procedures, and SOP-P3-L2-05 for lockout/tagout and confined space guidance where applicable.

Background and rationale
The shot blast cabinet is critical to surface preparation of ring-rolled forgings prior to downstream machining and inspection. Wear of the blast wheel liner and loss of shot media both degrade blasting efficiency, increase cycle variability, and accelerate wear to internal components. Regular inspection and preventive replacement of wear items minimizes unscheduled downtime and prevents damage to blast wheel components. Maintaining consistent media level preserves shot flow characteristics and reduces the risk of nozzle plugging and uneven blast coverage.

Mandatory values
- The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m.
- The shot media top-up interval for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 40 hours.

Tools
- Standard hand tools sufficient for access panel removal and fastener torqueing; use a calibrated torque wrench set to the specified torque for liner bolts.
- Inspection flashlight and wear gauge for liner and door seal inspection.
- Replacement liner hardware and gaskets as specified in ECN-2026-019.
- Clean container and sieve for media cleanliness check, plus approved shot media for top-up.
- Records log (electronic or paper) for maintenance entries, component serials, and media batch numbers.

Procedure
Preparation
- Review relevant safety procedures in SOP-P3-L2-05 and permit requirements in SOP-P3-L2-01 prior to work. Establish isolation and lockout per plant policy and verify energy sources are controlled.
- Inspect the area and prepare tools and parts at the worksite. Ensure access panels are clear and that a suitably calibrated torque wrench is available.

Inspection and fastener verification
- Remove the access cover for the blast wheel housing following the manufacturer access sequence. Visually inspect the blast wheel liner for wear patterns, cracks, or deformation. Pay attention to the liner segments adjacent to the wheel inlet and along the high-impact zone.
- Verify each liner bolt is torqued to the specified value. Use the calibrated torque wrench and set to the mandated torque prior to re-installation: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m.
- If any bolt does not meet the torque requirement due to head rounding, elongation, or thread damage, remove and replace the bolt with new hardware per ECN-2026-019 before proceeding.

Liner replacement guidance
- Replace liner segments when surface loss or deformation compromises the original profile such that grit retention or wheel clearance is outside acceptable contact geometry. When replacing, ensure mating surfaces are clean and gaskets or seals are seated correctly.
- Install new liner segments using manufacturer-specified orientation. Hand-start all bolts before performing final torque sequence to ensure even seating. Apply the specified torque to each bolt using the calibrated torque wrench.

Shot media inspection and top-up
- Confirm media cleanliness and particle integrity by sampling from the media hopper into the sieve and remove fines and contaminants. Maintain records of media batch or lot number when adding new media.
- Top up shot media according to operational consumption: The shot media top-up interval for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 40 hours. Use only approved shot media as documented in ECN-2026-019.
- After topping up, run a short verification cycle to confirm even media flow and absence of unusual noise or vibration. Observe machine behavior and inspect for dust leaks or abnormal discharge.

Reassembly and functional check
- Reinstall access covers and secure all fasteners. Verify guard and interlock function per SOP-P3-L2-01 requirements.
- Return the machine to service per SOP-P3-L2-05 procedures and monitor the first production run for consistent blast quality.

Examples and situational notes
- Example scenario: If an operator reports localized over-blasting on part circumferences, inspect the liner for localized thinning in the corresponding azimuth. Corrective action typically involves replacing the affected liner segment and verifying bolt torque per this manual.
- Example scenario: If media contamination is discovered during inspection, isolate the cabinet, remove contaminated media, clean the hopper, and replenish with certified media lots documented in ECN-2026-019.

Records to keep
- Maintenance log entry for each inspection and maintenance activity, including component serials and liner segment identifiers, media batch or lot numbers, and a note that the blast wheel liner bolt torque verification was performed to the specified value.
- Media top-up entries showing the interval reference and the media lot added; include operator name and machine shift where applicable.
- Any nonconformance or corrective action records generated and cross-referenced to ECN-2026-019 when parts or procedures differ from baseline.

Acceptance criteria
- Liner bolt torque verification complete and recorded with the specified torque applied: The blast wheel liner bolt torque for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 100 N·m.
- Blast wheel liners exhibit no cracks, catastrophic loss of section, or misalignment after maintenance. Wear patterns may be present but must not expose base structure or produce sharp edges that alter shot stream.
- Media level has been assessed and replenished per operational consumption and interval guidance: The shot media top-up interval for Ring Rolling shot blast cabinet #1 (EQ-P3-L2-SB01) is 40 hours. Media cleanliness confirmed and batch recorded.
- Functional check demonstrates consistent blast coverage and normal machine acoustics with no new leaks or abnormal vibrations.
- All records completed and filed according to plant document control and linked to ECN-2026-019, SOP-P3-L2-01, and SOP-P3-L2-05.

References
- ECN-2026-019
- SOP-P3-L2-01
- SOP-P3-L2-05
